def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, attn_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None):
        x = x + self.ln_attn(self.attention(self.ln_1(x), attn_mask=attn_mask))
        x = x + self.mlp(self.ln_2(x))
        return x
